title: alt+space cannot be rebound to disabled

status.label: Waiting for current-build clarification
status.detail: A July 30 comment asks whether the issue persists on 0.100.2+ and what Windows search surface opens; the issue has no later reporter reply.

next_action: Use the existing current-build clarification and test result to determine whether the failure is a Keyboard Manager remap problem or a Windows/PowerToys Run shortcut conflict.

judgment.rationale: The report is from PowerToys 0.61.1 and says Alt+Space remapped to Disabled still opens the Windows 10 search bar. A July 30, 2026 comment asks whether it persists on 0.100.2 or newer and requests clarification of which search UI appears; no later issue comment provides that answer. Open issue #30107 describes a similar Alt+Space/Windows Search conflict, but the exact target and current behavior in #39720 remain unconfirmed, so do not mark it a duplicate or propose a competing fix.

There is no subsequent reporter comment in the two-comment issue thread.
